title: Umushakashaka ukuri uhamye
intro: Mu gihe cyari gitwikiriwe n'ubujiji no gusenga imana z'ibinyoma, habayeho urugendo rukomeye rw'ukwemera. Uyu muntu yagerageje amahame y'umuryango we, ashaka Umuremyi umwe w'ukuri afite icyizere kidakuka. Itegure kuvumbura uwo roho ikomeje gushishikariza abantu benshi.
clues: Nabajije ibiri mu ijuru, nshaka Umwami nyakuri urema kandi agashyigikira byose.
Nategetswe kuva mu gihugu cyanjye, njya mu gihugu cyahawe umugisha n'Imana.
Nahanganye n'ibigirwamana by'ubwoko bwanjye, mpura n'ubusa bwabyo mu buryo butaziguye mbimenagura.
Abantu banjye banjugunye mu muriro ukaze, nyamara byahindutse bikonje kandi birangwa n'amahoro kuri njye bitewe n'itegeko rya Allah.
Nageragejwe n'itegeko ryo gutamba umwana wanjye w'imfura nkunda, ikigeragezo cyo kuganduka burundu.
Jye, hamwe n'umuhungu wanjye, twashinze imizi y'Ingoro ya mbere yo gusengeramo ku Isi, ahantu heza ho gusengera abantu bose.
arabic: قُلْنَا يَـٰنَارُ كُونِى بَرْدًۭا وَسَلَـٰمًا عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
verse: We [i.e., Allāh] said, "O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham." (21:69)
